label_source: Assistant-authored synthetic relevance judgments; not independently reviewed, not hiring outcomes.

grade_rubric.0: Unrelated or no demonstrated qualification fit
grade_rubric.1: Weak/adjacent fit or substantial required qualification gap
grade_rubric.3: Strong duties and stated qualification fit

limitations: Small synthetic diagnostic set, not representative of the population.
Labels need independent human review before weight selection.
Explicit seniority, missing credentials, negation and keyword bait are included as challenge cases.

experience.description: Six months building SQL queries and Python dashboards for spending reports.

experience.description: Two years resolving employee tickets and Windows connectivity issues.

profiles.resume_text: Synthetic candidate: three years office scheduling, data entry, answering phones, and helping residents.

experience.title: Accountant
experience.description: Three years reconciling municipal accounts and preparing financial statements. No supervisory experience or CPA credential.

experience.title: Program Assistant

jobs.title: Budget Data Analyst
jobs.description: Analyze municipal spending, build SQL queries and Python dashboards, and explain data to departments.
jobs.requirements: Bachelor degree; SQL, Python, data analysis and Excel.

jobs.title: Senior Data Science Manager
jobs.description: Lead an analytics team, manage budgets and develop machine learning strategy.
jobs.requirements: Eight years of analytics experience; three years supervising staff; Python and SQL.

jobs.title: IT Support Technician
jobs.description: Resolve help desk tickets, troubleshoot Windows devices and assist employees.
jobs.requirements: One year troubleshooting Windows and network connectivity; customer service.

jobs.title: Network Engineer
jobs.description: Design enterprise networks, configure routers and maintain firewall security.
jobs.requirements: Five years network engineering experience and CCNP certification.

jobs.title: Office Assistant
jobs.description: Answer phones, schedule appointments, enter records and assist residents.
jobs.requirements: Office experience, scheduling, data entry and customer service.

jobs.title: Municipal Accountant
jobs.description: Reconcile accounts, prepare financial statements and maintain the general ledger.
jobs.requirements: Accounting degree; two years reconciliation and Excel experience.

jobs.title: Finance Director
jobs.description: Lead the finance department, oversee municipal budgets and supervise accounting staff.
jobs.requirements: Ten years governmental accounting and five years management; CPA required.

jobs.title: Civil Engineering Associate
jobs.description: Assist with road design, drainage calculations and construction inspections.
jobs.requirements: Civil engineering degree; AutoCAD; Engineer in Training certification.

jobs.title: Senior Civil Engineer
jobs.description: Approve infrastructure designs, supervise engineers and oversee capital projects.
jobs.requirements: Arizona Professional Engineer license and seven years design experience required.

jobs.title: Recreation Program Coordinator
jobs.description: Plan community recreation programs, organize events and coordinate volunteers.
jobs.requirements: Two years community program experience; event planning and customer service.

jobs.title: Police Officer
jobs.description: Patrol assigned areas, respond to emergencies and enforce laws.
jobs.requirements: Arizona POST certification, physical fitness assessment and law enforcement training.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant
jobs.description: Compile requests for SQL and Python training; advanced programming experience is not required. Provide scheduling and data entry support.
jobs.requirements: Office administration and customer service. No data analysis responsibilities.
